sources.outlet: MedPAC, March 2022 Report to the Congress, Ch. 10 Long-term care hospital services
sources.quote: we estimate total Medicare-allowable costs and assess the relationship between Medicare’s payments and those costs, which we express as a payment margin.
sources.searcher_note: Method source: MedPAC's LTCH margins use Medicare-allowable cost, not booked expense. Names Kindred elsewhere in the chapter (one of two large LTCH chains; 61 Kindred LTCHs going into ScionHealth) but reports no Kindred-specific cost gap or margin. 'Medicare-allowable' breaks across a line in the PDF. Date is MedPAC's usual March 15 release, not printed on the page.

sources.quote: The initial annualized cash contractual base rent for the LTACs will be $80 million starting May 1, 2025, consistent with the Company’s previously announced expectations, and rent will escalate annually by 2.75%
sources.searcher_note: Context only: Kindred's rent on 23 LTACs leased from Ventas (plus $16M/yr on five sold-and-leased-back LTACs). Does not discuss cost reports, allowable cost, or margins versus peers.

notes: No source found reporting a gap between Kindred's booked expense and Medicare's cost-report cost line, the $178M figure, or the Kindred-vs-peer margin comparison (-6.7% vs +2.7%; 9.4 vs 0.8 points). Coverage of Kindred/ScionHealth finances is about debt, a distressed exchange (Moody's, via Private Equity Stakeholder Project), closures and Ventas sale-leasebacks, none of it cost-report margins. Modern Healthcare per-hospital cost-report margin pages for Kindred hospitals surfaced in search (e.g., Kindred Hospital South Florida) but returned 403, so not recorded. No disagreeing source found; no coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found. Several WebSearch calls ran extra internal searches beyond the logged query text.
